experiments.scope: Selected target r=2. The procedure is deterministic and organizer seeds are unused: every requested trial returns the same certified pair, recomputed from the preregistered SHA-256 s0 stream, the recorded executed root s1 and the line map of proof section 1. Observations report the program's computed bounds (gcd worst-case bound G(n), total operations W, time log2 x 1e6, peak words, memory bytes). The program contains the complete accounting of proof section 5.
experiments.hypothesis: The line map sends the preregistered s0 and the recorded root s1 to two distinct canonical inputs with equal complete digests; the reported accounting values are those used in the claim.
